description: Source code for managing and querying JIT operators in PyTorch, including registration, deregistration, lookup, and operator schema handling.

classes.name: OperatorRegistry
classes.description: Manages registration, deregistration, and lookup of operators, including handling operator schemas and signatures.

methods.name: registerOperator
methods.description: Registers a new operator, ensuring no duplicates and handling schema registration.

methods.name: deregisterOperator
methods.description: Removes an operator based on its schema.

methods.name: getAllOperators
methods.description: Returns a list of all registered operators.

methods.name: getOperators
methods.description: Returns operators associated with a specific symbol.

methods.name: getAllSortedOperatorsFor
methods.description: Returns operators for a symbol, sorted to ensure deterministic behavior.

methods.name: findOperatorFor
methods.description: Finds an operator matching a given full name.

methods.name: findSimilarOperators
methods.description: Finds operators similar to a given symbol based on edit distance.

methods.name: getOperatorForLiteral
methods.description: Retrieves an operator by its signature string.

methods.name: canonicalSchemaString
methods.description: Generates a canonical string representation of a function schema.
